meta.source: MoSPI, National Statistical Office (Annual Survey of Industries)
meta.revisionPolicy: ASI results are final on release; occasional revisions get a fresh vintage.
meta.coverage: All India × 2-digit NIC 2008 divisions; core indicators (factories in operation, fixed capital, gross output, GVA, persons engaged, emoluments)
meta.note: Monetary series are as published in the source: ₹ lakh (1 lakh = 100,000; 1 crore = 100 lakh). Count series (factories, persons) are plain counts. Survey years are fiscal (Apr–Mar), plotted at April of the first year. Divisions absent in a given year (small industries not surveyed separately) appear as disclosed gaps or shorter spans.
